title: [SEP2-8] The self-group gives relays a token that only one person's devices hold, which links that
description: Review finding SEP2-8: The self-group gives relays a token that only one person's devices hold, which links that person's devices, addresses and push handles (lens SEP2). Location: spec/02-identity.md:496; spec/04-access-control.md:158; ARCHITECTURE.md:395-401. Fix: As suggested. §9 accepts linkage of one device via push and same-address clustering, not linkage across a person's devices on different networks. A self-group token is followed only by the user's devices, which gives exactly that linkage. Add the sentence to the §9 push/address bullet, with the optional RECOMMEND of a distinct relay. Full text: notes/review2/SEP2-verified.md and notes/review2/SEP2.md.
